capabilities: Render fenced html code blocks as live previews in sandboxed iframes
Open .html and .htm files in a custom view with find-in-document and remembered scroll position
Embed HTML files inline via ![[file.html]] with an eye toggle to render
Save pasted HTML files to the vault and insert embed links
Choose how pasted HTML content is handled: render as a block, convert to markdown, or paste as text
disambiguation: Despite the name, it handles only HTML, not multiple programming languages.
extras: Manual installation only from GitHub releases; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents a security tradeoff: sandboxed frames have no localStorage or sessionStorage.
problem: Obsidian shows HTML code blocks as plain code and cannot open .html files, so HTML content must be moved to a browser to be viewed.
summary: Renders HTML code blocks and HTML files as live sandboxed previews inside Obsidian, with inline embeds and configurable paste handling.
